div.p: What SHE said about [her own] lack of strength to the confidante who informed [her] of the separation.

lg.l: peytupulan tiṟanta poṅkal veṇmaḻai
yeḵ[ku]ṟu pañciṟ ṟuytupaṭ ṭaṉṉa
tuvalai tūval ka[ḻi]ya vakalvayi
ṉiṭuka[ḻai]k karumpiṉ kaḷaikkāl vāṉpūk
kōṭaip pūḷaiyiṉ vāṭaiyoṭu tuyalvara
pā[ci]lai potuḷiya putaṟoṟum pakaṉṟai
nīluṇ paccai niṟamaṟai[t ta]ṭaicciya
tōleṟi pāṇ[ṭi]liṉ vāliya malarak
kō[ḻilai] yavaraik koḻumukai yuṭaiya
vūḻuṟu tōṉṟi yoṇpūt taḷaiviṭap
pulantoṟuṅ kurukiṉa naralak kalleṉa
vakaṉṟuṟai makaḷi raṇituṟantu naṭuṅka
vacciram vantaṉ ṟamaintaṉ ṟituveṉa
vepporuḷ peṟiṉum piriyaṉmi ṉōveṉac
cep[pu]val vāḻiyō tuṇaiyiṭai yirkkē
nalkāk kātalar nalaṉuṇṭu tuṟanta
pāḻpaṭu mēṉi nōkki nōypora
viṇariṟu puṭaiyu neñcamoṭu puṇarvuvēṭ
ṭeyiṟu[tī]p piṟappat tiruki
naṭuṅkutum piriyiṉyāṅ kaṭumpaṉi yuḻantē.
When the churning white clouds that opened over the fields have poured down
[and], as the drizzling of drops passes that were falling like
soft fibres of cotton put to the blade, in the vast area,
when the white flowers on the rugged stems of the sugarcane with steady stalks
come into swinging with the north wind as wool plants [do] in the west wind,
when on every bush that is dense with green leaves, the jalap
blooms in white [blossoms], like leather rounds under attack
on which [white] had been put, hiding the green colour that absorbed the blue(?),
while fat buds burst open on the field beans with fat leaves,
while the outer petals let go of the bright Malabar-lily flowers in [their] turn,
while flocks of herons trumpet in every field, noisily,
so that the women who stay in separation abandon [their] ornaments [and] shiver,
the cool season has come. “[This time] is suitable”, – since [HE] thought so,
“whatever kind of wealth may be obtained, please don’t part [from me]!”,
I say to you who is among [your] consorts , may you live.
While pain attacks [us] when looking at [our] ruined body
that is abandoned after [its] beauty had been consumed by an ungracious lover,
with a heart that breaks, broken [like a flower] cluster(?), wanting union,
gnashing [our] teeth so that sparks spring forth,
we will shiver if [HE] parts [from us], bearing the fierce dew.
